articles.title: Morgan Stanley Beats Estimates as Bank of America Misses on $1.2 Billion Settlement Charge
articles.excerpt: Morgan Stanley rode a 41% jump in equity trading and record wealth revenue to a clean beat, while a one-time compliance settlement pushed Bank of America below estimates despite growing core revenue.
articles.image_caption: The Morgan Stanley Building at 1585 Broadway in New York. Morgan Stanley beat third-quarter estimates on record wealth revenue and a 41% jump in equity trading.

articles.title: IMF's 20% US Crash Scenario Is a Diversification Test for NRI Portfolios
articles.excerpt: The Fund's downside case — a roughly 20% fall in US stocks if AI productivity disappoints — lands hardest on households whose 401(k), RSUs and brokerage all ride the same mega-cap trade.
articles.image_caption: The International Monetary Fund headquarters in Washington, DC. The IMF's October outlook models a downside scenario in which US stocks fall about 20%.
articles.nri_angle: US-based NRIs are typically triple-exposed to US mega-cap tech through 401(k)s, RSUs and brokerage accounts; the IMF scenario is a prompt to measure and cap that concentration.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Bengaluru Firm's Unpaid $672,102 Bill Exposes Payment Risk for Small IT Exporters
articles.excerpt: Ticvic Technologies says an overseas customer tested and accepted its software but has not paid for more than 19 months — a case analysts say shows why small Indian IT exporters must secure payment before delivery.
articles.image_caption: Bengaluru, seen from the Visvesvaraya Industrial and Technological Museum. A network-software firm in the city says it is still owed $672,102 for a completed project.

sources.label: GJEPC Solitaire — ECGC expanded export credit cover

articles.nri_angle: Small Indian IT firms selling through diaspora client networks abroad face the same lesson: relationship trust is no substitute for milestone payments and export-credit cover arranged before delivery.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

items.event: ECGC raises insurance ceiling from Rs 100 crore to Rs 300 crore.
ECGC session outlines insurance expansion for exporters.

articles.title: Cabinet Approves Fairfax's ₹52,878-Crore Bid for Controlling Stake in IDBI Bank
articles.excerpt: Fairfax will acquire 60.72% of IDBI Bank from the government and LIC in what New Delhi calls the largest FDI ever in India's financial sector, subject to RBI clearance.
articles.image_caption: An IDBI Bank branch. The Cabinet approved Fairfax's bid for a controlling stake in IDBI Bank.
articles.nri_angle: NRI depositors and investors in Indian banks get a new controlling shareholder at IDBI Bank, while the government and LIC remain minority holders with a combined 34%.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Indian IT Shares Surge as 'Anti-AI' Trade Lifts Nifty IT 2,000 Points in Two Days
articles.excerpt: HCLTech gained nearly 11% in two sessions after its Q2 results, with TCS and Infosys up 6-10%, as a global AI selloff driven by bubble warnings pushed investors toward Indian IT as the 'anti-AI' trade.
articles.image_caption: The Bombay Stock Exchange in Mumbai. Indian IT shares surged as the 'anti-AI' trade lifted the Nifty IT index 2,000 points in two days.
articles.nri_angle: Indian IT majors are among the most widely held India stocks in diaspora portfolios and retirement accounts; the two-day move recovers part of a steep year-long selloff driven by AI disruption fears.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: RBI Open to More Steps to Defend Rupee and Curb Forex Speculation, Governor Malhotra Says
articles.excerpt: Governor Sanjay Malhotra told Moneycontrol the central bank's recent curbs target speculative derivatives trading, not genuine hedging, and should not be read as capital controls. The rupee outperformed Asian peers after the measures.
articles.nri_angle: The rupee's level directly sets the value of NRI remittances and India-bound investments; the RBI's defence has lifted the currency from near record lows in recent sessions.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

items.text: Opened special dollar window for oil firms.
Aggressive market interventions to defend rupee.

articles.title: Bank Earnings Kick Off Mixed: JPMorgan Misses, Citi and Goldman Beat
articles.excerpt: JPMorgan posted its first earnings miss in 17 quarters as expenses climbed 12%, while Goldman Sachs rode a trading surge to the second-best revenue quarter in its history and Citigroup delivered its strongest third-quarter revenue in a decade.
articles.image_caption: A JPMorgan office tower at dusk, showing the bank's illuminated sign. JPMorgan Chase reported third-quarter earnings on Tuesday, missing analyst estimates for the first time in 17 quarters.
articles.nri_angle: US bank earnings set the tone for the markets where diaspora investors hold brokerage and retirement accounts; the season opened with trading strength offset by rising costs and credit provisions.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Sensex Jumps 1,109 Points as IT Rally and Rupee Recovery Drive Best Session in Four Months
articles.excerpt: The Sensex closed at 73,033.78 and the Nifty at 22,721.95 on Tuesday. HCLTech surged 8.28% on a 21% profit rise, TCS gained 6.59%, the Nifty IT index jumped over 5%, and breadth stayed weak beneath the headline — declines outnumbered advances on the BSE.
articles.nri_angle: For NRI investors, the session's drivers — IT earnings strength and a stabilising rupee — are the two variables that most directly move the value of India holdings measured in dollars.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Sitharaman: RBI Will Keep Fighting Rupee Volatility, But Will Not 'Fix' the Currency's Level
articles.excerpt: Speaking at the Bloomberg New Economy Forum, the Finance Minister blamed the rupee's 'very significant' slide over 18 months on external factors, noted it recovered 1% on Monday after the RBI's weekend measures — and called the debate on LTCG and STT rationalisation 'healthy' ahead of the February 1 Budget.
articles.image_caption: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman. She said the RBI will keep fighting rupee volatility but will not fix the currency's level.
articles.nri_angle: The RBI's FCNR(B) swap window drew $133 billion from the diaspora by August 31 — NRI deposits are now a frontline tool in the rupee's defence, and the exchange rate directly sets the value of every remittance home.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Johnson & Johnson Earnings Report Due Today: Key Insights to Watch
articles.excerpt: Investors anticipate insights into revenue trends and business performance.
articles.image_caption: Johnson & Johnson's headquarters in New Brunswick, New Jersey. The company reports quarterly earnings today.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: HCLTech Surges Seven Percent as Strong Results Lift Indian IT Stocks
articles.excerpt: HCLTech's September-quarter profit rose 21.2% and TCS gained 5.69%, as AI revenue, $3.26 billion in deal wins and a raised guidance floor lifted the Nifty IT index 3.12%.
articles.image_caption: An HCLTech office. HCLTech shares surged seven percent after strong quarterly results lifted Indian IT stocks.
articles.nri_angle: Indian IT shares are a core holding for many diaspora investors, and the rally signals improving earnings visibility for the sector that employs much of India's tech workforce.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India's Direct Selling Industry Hits Rs 23,522 Crore With 91 Lakh Sellers
articles.excerpt: The ADSEI-Kantar report counts nearly 43 lakh women among India's active direct sellers, projects Rs 25,000 crore in FY26 — and admits retention, not recruitment, is the industry's weak point.
articles.image_caption: A market in India. India's direct selling industry recorded Rs 23,522 crore in sales with 91 lakh active sellers.
articles.nri_angle: Direct selling reaches diaspora families through relatives earning in India; the report's own retention and income figures are the due diligence for any pitch.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

items.text: Majority of Sales from Wellness and Cosmetics
North India leads in market share

articles.title: Fed Minutes Signal Another Rate Hike Likely Before Year-End Despite Trump Pressure
articles.excerpt: Minutes from the September 15-16 meeting show most officials saw another increase as likely by year-end, after lifting the benchmark rate to 3.75%-4.00% despite President Trump's calls for cuts.
articles.image_caption: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh stands at the podium during a press conference at the Federal Reserve. Minutes from the September meeting signal that another rate increase is likely before the end of the year.
articles.nri_angle: Higher U.S. rates keep mortgage and borrowing costs elevated for Indian-American households and can support a stronger dollar, which affects the rupee value of money sent to India.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: HCLTech Profit Jumps 21% as Revenue Narrowly Misses Estimates; Forecast Floor Raised
articles.excerpt: Revenue of Rs 35,620 crore came in just under the LSEG consensus, but profit beat, deal wins hit $3.26 billion, and HCLTech narrowed its full-year growth range to 2.5%–4%.
articles.image_caption: HCLTech, the Indian IT services company that reported a 21% jump in profit as revenue narrowly missed estimates.
articles.nri_angle: For Indian tech workers and investors: fresher hiring rose and the deal book hit a first-half record, even as discretionary client spending stayed soft.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Indian Shares Lifted as Oil Eases and RBI's Rupee Defence Kicks In
articles.excerpt: The rupee jumped about 1% at Monday's open as the RBI's special dollar window for oil companies took effect and Brent slipped to $103 — though markets closed lower as crude stayed above $100 and foreign selling continued.
articles.image_caption: The Bombay Stock Exchange in Mumbai. Indian shares were lifted as oil prices eased and the RBI defended the rupee.
articles.nri_angle: For NRIs remitting money, the rupee's RBI-backed bounce matters at the margin: the currency opened near 95.77 per dollar after closing Friday at 96.73, so timing a transfer this week could move the received amount by roughly 1%.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Wall Street's top bosses shrug off rupee slide to double down on India
articles.excerpt: Blackstone expects to double its India assets to $100 billion while Brookfield plans to deploy over $100 billion in five years — even as foreign investors pull $30 billion from Indian stocks.
articles.nri_angle: The boom is powered as much by Indian domestic savings as Wall Street capital — investors should note the split between record IPO liquidity and sticky local flows on one side, and currency depreciation plus $30B in foreign outflows on the other.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

items.label: Average IPO banker fee in India

articles.title: RBI raises the cost of rupee hedges after corporate forward buying hits record
articles.excerpt: The Reserve Bank of India barred rebooking of cancelled rupee derivatives and imposed a 20% cash reserve on certain FX contracts — after corporate forward-dollar purchases surged to a record $77 billion in September.
articles.image_caption: A rupee sculpture stands at a Reserve Bank of India office, with the central bank's emblem on the wall behind it. The RBI has moved to raise the cost of corporate rupee hedging after record forward dollar buying.
articles.nri_angle: A record-weak rupee means each dollar sent home buys more rupees — historically strong timing for NRI remittances — while importers and dollar hedgers face 80–150 bps higher protection costs under the new RBI curbs.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: RBI Deploys Bond Sales and Rupee Defenses as Currency Tests Record Lows
articles.excerpt: A ₹250 billion bond sale, a CRR squeeze and a weekend FX package sent the rupee up 1% Monday — the RBI is now tightening on three fronts at once.
articles.nri_angle: Rupee weakness erodes remittance value and NRI deposit returns; the RBI's three-front tightening (rates, liquidity, FX) directly affects NRE deposit rates and the timing of India-bound transfers.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: HCL Tech Q2 Earnings Due Today: Six Signals Investors Will Watch
articles.excerpt: Results land after market close Monday with the stock 33% off its high — analysts expect 2–3% revenue growth and a guidance call that could reset the AI narrative.
articles.nri_angle: HCLTech is a core holding for many NRI investors and a major H-1B employer; Monday's guidance call will signal whether the 33% stock selloff on AI and immigration fears is overdone.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

items.text: AI revenue up 62.1% year-on-year to $171 million.
AI-led revenue still under 5% of total.

articles.title: Weak US Jobs Report Pushes October Fed Rate Hike Odds Below 25%
articles.excerpt: Just 29,000 jobs added in September against 90,000 expected, with steep downward revisions — futures markets now see the Fed standing pat at its October 27-28 meeting.
articles.image_caption: The Marriner S. Eccles Federal Reserve building in Washington, D.C. A weak September jobs report pushed October Fed rate-hike odds below 25%.
articles.nri_angle: NRI portfolios face the real tension: a Fed likely on hold in October but hiking in December keeps US mortgage rates elevated while supporting rate-sensitive equities — watch the December meeting, not October's.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

items.label: Jobs Revised Down in Prior Two Months

articles.title: Musk Vows Affordable Starlink in India, Escalating Feud With Ambani Before Jio's Record IPO
articles.excerpt: In X posts, Elon Musk promised affordable satellite internet to take on Reliance Jio, saying competition would benefit ordinary Indians — days before Jio Platforms' record $106 billion IPO.
articles.image_caption: Elon Musk at a formal event. Musk said SpaceX will price Starlink affordably in India to take on Reliance Jio, days before Jio Platforms' record IPO.
articles.nri_angle: A Starlink–Jio price war in satellite broadband could finally bring reliable high-speed access to rural areas where even 4G is patchy — directly changing what video calls home look like for diaspora families — while Jio's record IPO gives global investors direct exposure to the outcome.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

items.text: Mobile data costs about 8 cents per gigabyte.
Jio's pricing strategy built its dominance in the market.

articles.title: Japan Overtakes Singapore as India's Top FDI Source With $5.71 Billion in Q1
articles.excerpt: DPIIT data shows Japan invested $5.71 billion in April–June 2026 — nearly 29% of India's total equity FDI and more than it invested in all of FY26 — while US inflows collapsed 76%.
articles.image_caption: Soldiers carry the flags of India and Japan during an honour-guard ceremony. Japan invested $5.71 billion in India in the April–June 2026 quarter, becoming its largest source of foreign direct investment.
articles.nri_angle: The India–Japan capital corridor is thickening: two major Indian private banks now have Japanese anchor shareholders, and the 10-trillion-yen pipeline points to years of deployment. For US-based NRIs, the 76% collapse in American inflows is the flag — India-bound capital is changing nationality.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Jio sets IPO price band at ₹1,065–1,119 for ₹10.3 lakh crore valuation
articles.excerpt: Reliance Industries' digital arm plans to open subscriptions on October 21, aiming to raise about ₹30,200 crore in what would be India's largest-ever IPO — with no offer-for-sale by existing investors.
articles.image_caption: An editorial illustration of a Jio telecom tower with stock tickers and IPO documents. Jio has set its IPO price band at Rs 1,065-1,119 per share, valuing the company at about Rs 10.3 lakh crore.
articles.nri_angle: As India's largest-ever IPO and a barometer of global appetite for Indian equity, the Jio listing is accessible to non-resident investors through the NRI quota, and its valuation and listing-day performance will shape how the world prices India's digital infrastructure assets.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Private capital to drive 30 GW of India's 100 GW nuclear target by 2047
articles.excerpt: Atomic Energy Commission chairman A K Mohanty said opening the nuclear sector to private players could draw ₹7.5 lakh crore in investment, as India targets about 22 GW by 2031-32 under its Nuclear Energy Mission.
articles.image_caption: The Kudankulam Nuclear Power Plant in Tamil Nadu. Private firms are expected to contribute 30 GW toward India's 100 GW nuclear capacity target by 2047.
articles.nri_angle: For diaspora investors, nuclear power opens as a new investable theme in India for the first time, as the SHANTI Act lets private companies — including listed Indian engineering and power firms — enter a sector long closed to them, while Indo-US civil nuclear talks could bring American and Canadian reactor makers into the build-out.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: RBI Could Raise Repo Rate by 75–100 bps This Cycle, SBI Capital Says
articles.excerpt: SBI Capital Markets expects the repo rate to climb further from 5.5% as inflation persists, with a possible larger hike at the December MPC review depending on September and October price data.
articles.image_caption: The Reserve Bank of India headquarters in Mumbai. SBI Capital says the RBI could raise the repo rate by 75-100 bps this cycle.
articles.nri_angle: NRIs holding floating-rate home loans in India face higher EMIs as the tightening cycle runs; surplus savings in NRE/NRO fixed deposits should earn better rates.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: US Lifts Russian Diesel Sanctions Until April 2027 in Trump-Putin Deal
articles.excerpt: Trump announced phased Russian diesel deliveries after a call with Putin; the Treasury authorized Russian-origin diesel transactions through April 7, 2027, weeks before the midterms.
articles.image_caption: A roadside diesel price sign in the US displays $8.289 per gallon as a tanker truck passes on a highway. Washington has temporarily lifted sanctions on Russian diesel sales through April 2027 under a deal announced by President Trump.
articles.nri_angle: Indian refiners — major exporters of diesel and big buyers of Russian crude — could see export margins squeezed if sanctioned-lifted Russian diesel floods global markets.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Adani Green H1: Capacity Up 24% to 20,763 MW, Energy Sales Jump 32%
articles.excerpt: The renewables major added 4,083 MW of greenfield capacity and commissioned 3,081 MWh of battery storage at Khavda; the board meets October 21 to approve Q2 results.
articles.image_caption: An aerial view shows rows of solar panels at a large solar farm. Adani Green Energy reported operational capacity of 20,763 MW for the first half, up 24% from a year earlier.
articles.nri_angle: Adani stocks are widely held by diaspora investors tracking India's renewable-energy story; the October 21 results are the next checkpoint on that thesis.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

data_cards.card_title: Adani Green H1FY27 at a Glance

articles.title: GST Council Axes Arrest Powers, Halves Penalties in Sweeping Compliance Overhaul
articles.excerpt: The 57th Council meeting recommended removing GST officers' arrest powers, raising the prosecution threshold to ₹5 crore, and automating refunds and registrations — with no rate changes on the table.
articles.image_caption: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman addresses a media briefing after the 57th GST Council meeting at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, on October 8, 2026. The Council recommended removing GST officers’ arrest powers and halving the general penalty.
articles.nri_angle: For NRIs running India operations or investing in Indian SMEs, the compliance overhaul lowers one of the biggest frictions of doing business in India — arbitrary enforcement risk — which is exactly the kind of structural change that moves the needle on India's ease-of-doing-business story.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

items.event: Target implementation date for new recommendations.

articles.title: Sensex Surges 879 Points as IT Stocks Lead Broad-Based Market Rebound
articles.excerpt: The Sensex and Nifty each gained more than 1% on Friday, led by a 3% IT rally on strong TCS results — but persistent FII selling and Monday's CPI print will decide if the bounce holds.
articles.image_caption: The Bombay Stock Exchange building is shown with rising market arrows. The Sensex gained 879.09 points on October 9, 2026 to close at 72,472.33, while the Nifty 50 rose 1.30% to 22,520.45.
articles.nri_angle: For NRI investors with Indian equity exposure, Friday's bounce cut the week's earlier damage — but with FIIs still selling and the RBI's tightening cycle underway, the recovery hinges on Q2 earnings delivery rather than one day's short covering.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Nifty 50 Profits Seen Growing 20% as Earnings Accelerate Despite Market Slump
articles.excerpt: Five brokerages expect Nifty 50 net profit to rise about 20% in the September quarter, building on a 10-quarter high — even as record foreign selling pushes the index toward its worst year in 15.
articles.image_caption: A trader monitors stock prices on a screen at a brokerage in Mumbai. Brokerages forecast Nifty 50 net profit growth of about 20% for the September quarter, even as foreign investors sell Indian equities at a record pace.
articles.nri_angle: Diaspora investors with India mutual fund, ETF or direct equity exposure face a split: record foreign selling has crushed the Nifty while corporate profits accelerate — earnings season will show whether fundamentals reassert themselves.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Is Indian Manufacturing's Moment Finally Here? The Data Is Mixed
articles.excerpt: The Economist says Indian industry is having its moment — but factory surveys, PLI payout data, and value-addition figures paint a more complicated picture.
articles.image_caption: The Bokaro Steel Plant in Jharkhand. India's manufacturing PMI rose to 55.1 in September, a seven-month high — though steel, batteries, solar and textiles lag behind electronics assembly.
articles.nri_angle: NRIs investing in India need a clear-eyed read: manufacturing's gains are concentrated in electronics, pharma and food processing, while batteries, solar and textiles lag — pick exposure by sector, not by theme.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Fed's Waller Signals More Rate Hikes as 10-Year Yield Nears 24-Year High
articles.excerpt: The Fed governor left the door open for a pause at the October 27-28 meeting, but warned inflation remains more than a point above target as oil prices surge past $104.
articles.image_caption: Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller signaled Thursday that additional interest-rate hikes will likely be needed to bring inflation back to the Fed's 2% target.
articles.nri_angle: Higher U.S. yields strengthen the dollar against the rupee, raise borrowing costs, and pull foreign capital away from Indian markets — all directly affecting NRI investors and remittance senders.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

items.text: Inflation is above Fed's 2% target by over 1%.
Weekly jobless claims at 197,000, below forecast of 200,000.

articles.title: TCS Beats Street Estimates as Q2 Profit Rises 15% to ₹13,884 Crore
articles.excerpt: India's largest software exporter reported ₹73,188 crore in revenue, declared a ₹12 interim dividend, and crossed a $3 billion annualised AI revenue run-rate on two landmark transformation deals with Porsche and Best Buy.
articles.image_caption: A Tata Consultancy Services campus in Electronic City. TCS reported Q2 profit of Rs 13,884 crore, beating street estimates.
articles.nri_angle: TCS is the anchor blue-chip for many diaspora investors in Indian equities; its 15% profit beat, ₹12 dividend with an October 14 record date, and $9.6 billion deal pipeline signal stability in Indian IT during a volatile market week.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Sensex Tanks 900 Points, Nifty Slides Below 22,300 as RBI Hike Selloff Deepens
articles.excerpt: Indian benchmarks extended their fall in midday trade on Thursday, October 8, a day after the RBI raised the repo rate to 5.50% and shifted its stance to 'calibrated tightening.' IT heavyweights TCS, Infosys and HCLTech bucked the selloff ahead of TCS's quarterly results.
articles.image_caption: A red downward-trending arrow over a grid of falling bar charts and negative percentage figures. The Sensex and Nifty 50 both fell more than 1% in midday trade on Thursday, October 8, after the RBI's repo rate hike.
articles.nri_angle: A near-record-low rupee means remitted dollars buy more rupees, but sustained FII selling and a rising-rate cycle are headwinds for NRI portfolios with Indian equity exposure.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Asia Stocks Fall as Oil Surge, Rising Yields Weigh; Samsung Slips on Record Profit
articles.excerpt: MSCI's Asia-Pacific index fell 0.3% on Thursday as Brent crude topped $104 a barrel on U.S.-Iran escalation fears and 10-year Treasury yields neared multi-decade highs. Samsung Electronics slid despite a record $80 billion quarterly profit after the result fell short of some analyst estimates.
articles.image_caption: The market centre at the Tokyo Stock Exchange. Asian stocks fell as surging oil prices and rising bond yields weighed on markets.
articles.nri_angle: Surging oil prices and rising U.S. yields are direct headwinds for India as a major oil importer, pressuring the rupee, fuel prices and foreign investor flows into Indian equities.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Foreign Investors Pulled ₹21,745 Crore From Indian Stocks in Late September
articles.excerpt: Foreign portfolio investors sold ₹21,745 crore ($2.3 billion) of Indian equities in the second half of September, intensifying a selloff led by financials, oil & gas, and auto stocks as rising US yields and crude prices drove a global allocation reset.
articles.image_caption: A candlestick stock chart illustrating the September 2026 wave of foreign outflows from Indian equities. FPIs withdrew roughly Rs 35,860 crore from Indian stocks during the month.
articles.nri_angle: For NRIs with Indian equity exposure, the selloff is a global-allocation rotation rather than an India-specific verdict — and with domestic institutions absorbing more than foreigners sold, SIP flows and large-cap entry points look healthier than the outflow headlines suggest.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk
